title: Choir and Spire
author: Bram Sterling
blurb: Vesper Vane, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
